guidance: For this year, getting down to a quick outlook for this fiscal, we are expecting about 50,000 tons of sales for H2, taking the overall to the region of 90,000- 95,000 tons for the year.
A sales level we expect to cross INR2,000 crores for FY27.
capex: Our capacity, as we speak, is 130,000 tons.
From 120 lakh, we have added a 4,000-ton press at our Viralimalai plant, so our capacity has gone up from 120,000- 130,000 tons.
risks: I just want to understand, a couple of quarters back, you talked about there is a movement towards tractor-trailer that is leading to pressure in growth because we were tuned to multi-axle trucks.
Nipurn Khemka: Why has the company been so slow to capitalize assets, and why has there been a delay of 16,500 tons, and how much is the cost escalation, if any?
focus: Some are expansion of existing product lines, some are new product lines, some are for new customers.
There's a good potential for us to focus on the exports, which is why I'm pretty bullish on export revenue.
I should have looked at this number in the last few months, and we have been very busy with customer side and focusing on deliveries quite a bit.
quals: Once the press starts production in Q4 FY27, how long do OEM qualifications typically take for heavy parts, and what does the ramp-up look like there?
OEM qualifications can take anywhere from six months to two years, depending upon the OEM, the depth of engagement with them, and the launch of that particular part from that OEM.
Qualification is almost pre- done, you can say.
